rule: a smoke that is ok has no failed step

instance.label: five-node lifecycle smoke: five real keyval-server processes on this machine, two killed with SIGKILL and restarted, then every data directory examined offline

steps.expected: every node's applied index ≥ the last acknowledged write's index 31
steps.observed: after 60s, not at index 31: node 4 applied 29

limitations: process-crash evidence only: a SIGKILL ends the process but the page cache survives (D-46, §10.17, §10.15)
